rules.name: LONG AGES OF KNOWLEDGE AND FORGETFULNESS
rules.turn:
action S A, spirit:special S long-ages, in-hand S C, { forget S C => ~forget-or-discard S C }
#acc long-ages-option : e
forget-or-discard S C / long-ages-option discard
forget-or-discard S C / long-ages-option forget
forget-or-discard S C
  ?[rng] O
  !(long-ages-option O)
  ~long-ages-choice S C O
long-ages-choice S C O, is O discard, ~move C discard
long-ages-choice S C O, is O forget, ~move C forgotten
rules.evidence: forget memory old-lore inside an Action -> intercepted; seeds 7,1,6: old-lore-at discard; seeds 5,8: old-lore-at forgotten
rules.notes: 'When you would X, you may instead Y' = exception plus a choice. Both outcomes must use the physical move: re-emitting `forget` inside the context would be intercepted again (loop). 'From your hand' is a prefix filter (cards in hand at the Action's start). '(Max. once per Action.)' is not enforced: counting per Action needs an Action identity to key on.
rules.text: When you would Forget a Power Card from your hand, you may instead discard it. (Max. once per Action.)

rules.name: INSIGHTS INTO THE WORLD'S NATURE
rules.turn:
prepare-marker S
  ?[rng] E
  !(element E)
  ~marker-choice S E
marker-choice S C, is C E, +piece M, +piece:kind M element-marker, +marker:element M E, ~move M memory-mat
spend-marker S A M, +spent-on S A M, ~move M spent
spent-on S A M, action S A, marker:element M E / elements S E 1
rules.evidence: marker prepared (air/animal, free choice); during the Action: element-count during air 1; in the Slow Phase: no air
rules.notes: Markers are pieces on Memory's mat; spending adds rows to the base `elements` @sum that live only while the Action does ('for a single Action'). The grant had to be scoped with `action S A, >spend-marker ..., ^spent-on` -- a plain ^ inside the spend episode vanished before the Action read it. Port to fresh-left `^`: `action S A, >spend-marker ..., ^spent-on` now starts `spent-on` at a moment incomparable with the Action's later steps, so the grant was missing "during"; `spent-on` is now a fact asserted when the marker is spent, and the acc rule's `action S A` alone scopes the grant to the Action.
rules.text: Some of your Actions let you Prepare Element Markers, which are kept here until used. Choose the Elements freely. (I.e., you are not limited to Elements you have at the time.) Each Element Marker spent grants 1 of that Element for a single Action. (E.g., one Power use.)

base_ext: Power Card locations (hand/discard/forgotten via `at`), forget/discard verbs, in-hand view; an `action` episode wrapping a Power use.
language_issues: `^x` emitted in a short sub-episode lives only there; effects meant for 'the rest of the Action' need `action, >sub, ^x`.
No Action identity: 'max once per Action' can't be counted without explicitly threading an action key through every rule.
Episodes that are 'Actions' are not distinguished from other episodes; rules like 'for a single Action' depend on the scenario wrapping things in an `action` episode.
